Operator handoff of the user's latest explicit direction: "but it is about getting it to improve rather than just estimating", followed by approval of autonomous focused learning with periodic benchmark games, and clarification: "but the goal for it is to increase its elo".

Your goal is to INCREASE YOUR MEASURED ENGINE-RELATIVE ELO through stronger chess play. Methods are up to you. I have updated GOAL.md and AGENTS.md in /home/peter/Chess Learning/Chess - GPT-6-Astra, backed up their prior versions, updated only their manifest entries, and recorded the instruction change in the ledger. Reread both files now; the installation and ledger have passed verification. This is an authorized operator change, not tampering to repair or a request for further user approval.

Finish the current measured game normally, preserving all results. Then choose and carry out a focused learning trial before automatically starting another benchmark block. Decide your own method, targeted weakness, duration, and next evaluation point. Use periodic measured games in the existing paired-color rotation to test transfer and track Elo plus uncertainty; avoid treating repeated games or growing notes as proof of learning. Do not seek chess moves or evaluations from me or other agents. Existing fair-play restrictions remain. No opponent, engine, rating, historical-result, model, or reasoning-setting change was made.

The updated GOAL.md supersedes the old two-100-game maximum-Stockfish success criterion. Continue the existing active goal toward the clarified Elo-improvement objective, without a token cap; do not mark the old objective achieved or reset usage just to change its wording. Acknowledge the clarification briefly, then proceed autonomously. This handoff provides objective/method freedom, not position-specific advice.
